title: The comparison map between pullback and the right adjoint is an isomorphism for a perfect first factor
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter duality.tex (Duality for Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file duality.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a morphism f : X -> Y of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes, the lemma asserts that the map Lf^*K otimes^L a(L) -> a(K otimes^L L) defined above is an isomorphism when K is perfect, and in particular that the comparison map of equation labelled equation-compare-with-pullback is an isomorphism for perfect K (statement lines 2084-2116). Letting K^vee be the dual of K by Cohomology, Lemma labelled cohomology-lemma-dual-perfect-complex, the proof computes for M in D_QCoh(O_X) the three term chain Hom_{D(O_Y)}(Rf_*M, K otimes^L L) = Hom_{D(O_Y)}(Rf_*M otimes^L K^vee, L) = Hom_{D(O_X)}(M otimes^L Lf^*K^vee, a(L)) = Hom_{D(O_X)}(M, Lf^*K otimes^L a(L)), where the second equality uses the definition of a and the projection formula of Cohomology, Lemma labelled cohomology-lemma-projection-formula-perfect or the more general Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-cohomology-base-change (proof lines 2118-2132). The result follows by the Yoneda lemma (proof lines 2132-2134). Dualising the perfect factor so that the projection formula applies, and concluding by Yoneda, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
